lines.text: A king will reign in righteousness, and each ruler will be like streams of water in a dry land.
The fool leaves the hungry empty, while a noble man makes honorable plans and stands up for worthy causes.
The complacent women will tremble in a little more than seventy years, because the grape harvest will fail.
The palace will be forsaken until the Spirit is poured out, and then the desert will be a vineyard.
Justice will inhabit the wilderness, and the work of righteousness will be peace.
